title: Don't Even Scream: The Narwhal Incident
skyStory: The moon is nearly gone, a four percent sliver dozing in Sagittarius, and when the moon naps the coincidence department works overtime. Sagittarius has fired an arrow with two names written on it. It will land somewhere between the cabin and the shore before supper. The candle leans forward. Something absurd is coming, and everyone in the sky knows it.

reading: Today you will think, for no reason at all, about a narwhal. Maybe it shows up on a kid's sweater, maybe in a crossword clue, maybe your brain just serves it up while you wait for the kettle. Hold onto that narwhal. Do not tell anybody yet.

Around 4:20 pm, Nancy will bring up a narwhal too, unprompted, in a story that has nothing to do with whales. Don't even scream. The [[Wheel of Fortune]] is spinning on the tusk of a sea unicorn now. Reply with a hand-drawn narwhal, as bad as possible. Quality is not the point. Proof is.
joel.mission: Draw a narwhal in under thirty seconds, badly, and keep it in your pocket until evening.
joel.omen: Something spiral-shaped in an ordinary place, like a shell or a screw. It means the promised coincidence is right on time.
joel.stoneWhy: a single bright point, like a tusk

reading: The shore is grey and quiet, and you will feel a funny pull toward sea creatures today. A picture on a mug. A word in a book. A child at the next table explaining narwhals to an adult who did not ask. Your Wood Rat ears will catch every word.

When the coincidence lands, and it will, you are allowed one small, dignified gasp. ΔΕΣ is rarely this specific, and the universe is clearly showing off. Tell Joel the full story with both hands, tusk gestures encouraged. The [[Two of Cups]] says some links are just funny on purpose.
nancy.mission: Tell a story today that includes an animal impression, and commit to it fully.
nancy.omen: A child explaining a fact to an adult. It means someone will soon ask you for advice, and you will nail it.
nancy.stoneWhy: from the sea, like today's guest

together.text: Tonight, each of you names the sea creature you would be if the universe handed out ocean spirits. No explaining until both have answered. Compare. If you picked the same one, that is two DES events in a single day and you must both lie down.
